授業概要
構造セラミックス材料学の全体的な理解を得ることが出来る。そして、材料の結晶構造や欠陥、セラミックス概論、セラミックプロセッシング、酸化物、窒化物、炭化物、複合材料、ナノセラミックス材料、セラミックスコーティング、先端セラミックスの最先端技術、応用について講義する。
In these lectures, students will gain an overall understanding of structural ceramics materials science. The lectures will be given regarding crystal structures, defects of materials, ceramics introduction, ceramic processing, oxides, nitrides, carbides, composites, nano-ceramic materials, ceramic coatings, and the cutting-edge technologies and applications of advanced ceramics.

全体の教育目標
The overall aim of this course is for students to learn about ceramics processing as well as fundamental concepts in the fields of structural ceramics and materials-properties based on materials science.
個別の教育目標
This course is specifically aimed at helping students to learn the various properties of structural ceramics, ceramics coatings, composites and the importance of advanced materials.
授業計画
lecture 1: Introduction to Ceramics–I
lecture 2: Introduction to Ceramics–II
lecture 3: Ceramics Processing
lecture 4: Oxide Ceramics
lecture 5: Transparent Ceramics
lecture 6: Nitride Ceramics、Carbide Ceramics
lecture 7: Nano Composites
lecture 8: Ceramics Coatings
キーワード
Structural Ceramics, Crystal Structure, Processing, Sintering, Oxide, Nitride, Carbide, Composites, Coatings
授業の進め方
Lectures in English will consist of PowerPoint explanations on the main themes of each lecture, understanding through discussing and reading of handout materials including short tests.
テキスト
The textbook “Introduction to Ceramics” by W. David Kingery (Wiley-Interscience, 1976) and Ceramic Materials by C.Barry Carter (Springer, 2013) will be used to introduce fundamental concepts related to structural ceramics.
